sites.name: Global Innovation and Technology Center
sites.description: Houses the Product, Packaging, Raw Material, Process and Dispense Development teams, with labs, an experimental brewery and sensory analysis.

source.label: Anheuser-Busch InBev Form 20-F for fiscal year 2024
source.quote: The Global Innovation and Technology Center, located in Leuven, Belgium, accommodates the Product, Packaging, Raw Material, Process and Dispense Development teams and has facilities such as Labs, Experimental Brewery and Sensory Analysis.

notes: All figures are from the FY2024 20-F, which reports plants and employees only by business segment. The 20-F defines North America as the United States and Canada and South America as Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay, so those regions carry country lists; Middle Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific include 'other ... countries' and get null. Global Export and Holding Companies (5,662 employees) is not a geography and is left out. No country, U.S.-state or tax-by-country breakdown was found in the 20-F, and a web search found no AB InBev tax-by-country report. Anheuser-Busch's U.S. 'Economic Impact' page (anheuser-busch.com) shows only national figures (65,000 people, 100 facilities) and blocks automated fetches, so it was not used.
